facts.fact: Agence Ecofin reports that the minister of digital affairs said on 21 November 2024 the government plans to connect 18 more communes to fibre by mid-2025 to extend broadband to all 77 communes, as part of the broadband deployment project of the Programme d'action du gouvernement 2021-2026, costed at about 207 billion FCFA.
facts.system: Déploiement de l'Internet haut et très haut débit sur l'ensemble du territoire national

facts.fact: The minister said in the government's own accountability broadcast on 21 November 2024 that the national backbone already links 50 communes over about 2,550 km, against a target of 3,300 km of fibre.
